author: shad364
body:
Again, on the next game xneon splashes me with a slowness potion and repeatedly tries blowing me up with TNT, saying "diamonds" then when I look away he uses fire charges to burn me. I was on Skype with my friend who (as you see in chat) is trying to make him stop.

I would also like point out the issue of the amount of killers on this game and lack of mods. Me and my friend are active players on this server and play on walls almost every day and 6/10 games there's someone who tries to team kill us or someone else.
